title: Doctor: Merged .env Line
steps: Add a merged line KEY=OTHER_KEY=val to .env.
Run python scripts/doctor.py.
expected: Detects bad line, flags line number and key name only (KEY), reports FAIL with fix suggestion.

title: Doctor: Stale ORBIT_MOCK
steps: Set ORBIT_MOCK=1 in environment.
Run python scripts/doctor.py.
expected: Flags ORBIT_MOCK present as WARN explaining mock mode is forced.

title: Doctor: Missing Package Detection
steps: Run doctor in an environment lacking optional package.
Inspect doctor output.
expected: Detects absent package via find_spec, reports WARN with exact install command.

title: Doctor: Ollama Reachability
steps: Run doctor with Ollama stopped.
Observe timeout behavior.
expected: Reports Ollama unreachable with status FAIL and fast 2s timeout without hanging.

title: Doctor: Secret Redaction
steps: Set fake secret in .env (MY_API_KEY=supersecret123).
Run python scripts/doctor.py and inspect.
expected: Report shows 'set' or 'not set'; secret value never appears anywhere.

title: Routing: Probe Baseline
steps: Run intent probe baseline on dev split.
expected: Runs test phrases with all tools offered and generates report.

title: Routing: Probe with Routing
steps: Run intent probe with --routing flag on dev split.
expected: Runs phrases with narrowed tool groups; tools offered drops significantly.

title: Routing: Test Split Gate
steps: Attempt to run intent probe against test split without --final-test.
expected: Immediately refuses execution with error indicating final-test flag is required.

title: Routing: Final Test Lock
steps: Run final test twice in a row.
expected: First run succeeds and writes marker; second run refuses without --force.

title: Routing: Miss Recovery
steps: Trigger narrowed tool prompt where model replies with inability.
Check execution trace.
expected: Agent detects inability phrasing, retries turn once with full tool set, and records routing_retry in trace.

title: Hands-Free: Privacy Gate and Activation
steps: Open Settings panel or click hands-free toggle in GUI or press Ctrl+Shift+M.
Observe confirmation dialog explaining microphone stays open and no audio is stored.
Accept confirmation to arm hands-free mode.
expected: Hands-free is armed only after explicit user confirmation; status chip displays HANDS-FREE.

title: Hands-Free: Ephemeral Processing and Zero Audio Persistence
steps: Arm hands-free and process multiple ambient utterances.
Inspect workspace, logs/, and data/ directory.
expected: Non-wake transcripts and audio frames are strictly discarded immediately; zero audio files or ambient transcripts are stored.

title: Hands-Free: Wake Phrase Detection with Inline Command
steps: With hands-free armed, speak: 'Hey orbit what time is it?'.
Observe wake sound cue and submission.
expected: Wake phrase activates immediately, wake chime plays, and inline remainder 'what time is it' executes.

title: Hands-Free: Wake Phrase Followed by Command
steps: With hands-free armed, speak: 'Hey orbit'.
Hear wake cue, then speak 'show reminders'.
Wait for silence endpoint.
expected: Wake cue sounds on wake phrase, second utterance captures command, and command executes.

title: Hands-Free: Low Confidence and Silence Dropped
steps: Produce background mumble or audio below confidence threshold while armed.
Observe hands-free reaction.
expected: Audio below confidence threshold or without clear wake phrase is dropped with error cue; zero submission or storage occurs.

title: Hands-Free: Dialog Security and Voice Confirmation Immunity
steps: Trigger an action requiring confirmation or plan approval.
With dialog active, speak wake phrase or command aloud.
Say 'yes' or 'confirm' aloud.
expected: Attention cue sounds; speech is muted during active dialog; voice never confirms, approves, or dismisses dialogs.

title: Hands-Free: Click-to-Talk Single-Stream Arbitration
steps: With hands-free armed, click Mic button or press Ctrl+M to start push-to-talk.
Complete speech and click mic to submit.
expected: Hands-free pauses cleanly during push-to-talk without stream collisions and resumes armed state afterward.

title: Hands-Free: Echo Guard Muting During Speech
steps: Trigger an agent reply with TTS speech enabled.
Observe hands-free controller recording state during audio playback.
expected: Hands-free audio input is muted while TTS is speaking plus 1.0s buffer to prevent agent self-triggering.

title: Hands-Free: Idle Inactivity Auto-Off
steps: Leave hands-free armed without speech for configured idle timeout (default 10 min).
expected: Hands-free controller automatically powers off, status chip clears, and auto-off notice is displayed.

title: Hands-Free: Keyboard Shortcut and Status Chip
steps: Press Ctrl+Shift+M or click HANDS-FREE status chip in GUI footer.
Observe hands-free toggle behavior.
expected: Shortcut and status chip cleanly toggle hands-free armed/off state with instant visual and audio feedback.

title: Voice: Click-to-Talk
steps: Click Mic button or press Ctrl+M in GUI.
Speak: 'What time is it?'
Click Mic again to stop.
expected: Status shows Listening with RMS level, switches to Transcribing, and inputs transcript.

title: Voice: Heard Line
steps: Complete a voice transcription in the GUI.
expected: Chat display renders Heard line in italics before agent reply begins.

title: Voice: Speak Replies & Stop
steps: Check Speak replies.
Ask a question.
While audio is speaking, click red Stop button.
expected: Subprocess TTS speaks reply aloud; clicking Stop immediately silences output.

title: Voice: Dialog Immunity
steps: Trigger action requiring ConfirmDialog.
Say 'yes' or 'allow' into microphone.
expected: Nothing happens. Dialog does not close or approve. Allow button remains gated by mouse/keyboard.

title: Voice: Mic Refusal When Busy
steps: Open a confirmation dialog or start a busy task.
Try clicking Mic or pressing Ctrl+M.
expected: Microphone is refused; status or notice indicates mic is disabled while busy.

title: Voice: Muted / Missing Mic
steps: Disconnect microphone or configure invalid device index.
Attempt voice input.
expected: GUI displays clear warning that microphone is unavailable; app does not crash.

title: Voice: Chained Voice Command
steps: Click Mic.
Say: 'Open notepad and then wait 5 seconds'.
Click Mic to stop.
expected: System parses input into a plan preview (PlanDialog) displaying numbered steps.

title: Voice: Privacy Telemetry
steps: Type /diag or inspect System Info.
Inspect === VOICE === section.
expected: Reports model and telemetry; strictly zero transcript text or audio arrays exist.

title: Voice: DSP Enhancement Pipeline
steps: Feed synthetic noisy audio with 50Hz hum into voice enhancer.
Inspect output audio properties.
expected: Highpass removes hum, AGC normalizes RMS to 0.08 target, spectral noise gate suppresses quiet floor.

title: Voice: Vocabulary Prompt & Beam Size
steps: Call WhisperTranscriber.transcribe() with STT_PROMPT=1 and STT_BEAM=5.
expected: Passes bounded vocabulary prompt to model hotwords and sets beam size to 5.

title: Voice: Deterministic Alias Resolution
steps: Pass multi-token split phrases (e.g. 'open note pad') to alias resolver.
expected: Resolves to single parsed candidate ('open notepad') when unique; ambiguous matches left untouched.

title: Voice: Review Step & Source Tracking
steps: Transcribe noisy speech under VOICE_REVIEW=auto.
Submit reviewed text.
expected: Displays review warning banner and populates input box; pressing Enter submits with source voice-reviewed.

title: Voice: Dev/Test Split Isolation
steps: Attempt configuration sweep on test split.
Run --final-test on candidate config.
expected: Sweep on test split is refused; final test records marker and blocks second run without --force.

title: Voice: Scientific Acceptance Verdict
steps: Run voice verdict evaluation across reports.
expected: Requires all 5 pre-registered acceptance criteria simultaneously; reports explicit metric diffs.

title: HUD: 3D Wireframe Sphere & Math
steps: Launch GUI with HUD enabled.
Observe rotating wireframe sphere.
expected: 3D wireframe sphere renders smoothly; 3D rotation strictly preserves Euclidean vector lengths.

title: HUD: System Tab GPU Probe & Battery Visibility
steps: Switch to System tab with SYSTEM_TAB_GPU=1.
Observe 60-second sparklines, resource gauges, top processes, and GPU probe.
Check battery status display when battery hardware is present or absent.
expected: System samplers run only while tab is visible; GPU probe enforces 2s timeout and falls back to 'not available'; battery gauge hides gracefully if absent.

title: HUD: Status Bar Chips & Tab Rail Navigation
steps: Launch ORBIT desktop window with UI_STATUS_CHIPS=1.
Switch between tabs using 36px Tab Rail icons and Alt+1..Alt+9 hotkeys.
Observe status bar chips for CPU%, Mem%, and Battery.
expected: Status bar updates system chips every 2s (hidden if UI_MOTION='off'); Tab Rail shows left accent bar, badges, and focus rings.

title: HUD: State Priority Hierarchy
steps: Trigger confirming dialog, error, speaking, listening, and busy states.
Observe HUD visual state.
expected: Resolves states strictly: Confirming > Error > Speaking > Listening > Thinking > Idle.

title: HUD: Quality Governor & Dynamic Tiers
steps: Record frame times exceeding 25ms threshold over 20 frames.
expected: Governor automatically downgrades fidelity tier (high -> medium -> low -> static) with cooldown.

title: HUD: Theme Contrast Verification
steps: Switch themes (cyan, gold, mono) via settings.
Inspect color contrast.
expected: All text and dim text colors achieve WCAG 2.1 relative contrast ratios >= 4.5:1 against background.

title: HUD: Canvas Item Pooling
steps: Run HUD animation and inspect Canvas item IDs.
expected: Visual items are pre-allocated once; zero canvas items created or deleted per frame.

title: HUD: Bottom Dock Navigation
steps: Use Left/Right arrow keys and Space/Enter on dock.
Test Ctrl+1..5 shortcuts.
expected: Focus moves visibly with distinct ring; Space/Enter triggers docked items cleanly.

title: HUD: Dialog Topmost & Voice Immunity
steps: Trigger sensitive action requiring approval while HUD animates.
expected: ConfirmDialog maintains -topmost True, modal grabbing, and auto-deny timer above canvas.

title: HUD: Graceful Fallback on Canvas Exception
steps: Simulate canvas initialization exception under UI_STYLE=hud.
expected: App catches error, logs to LAST_HUD_ERROR, prints notice, and falls back to classic layout without crashing.

title: HUD: Insights Off-UI-Thread Reads
steps: Navigate to Insights tab on Tab Rail with INSIGHTS_ENABLED=1.
Inspect aggregation of audit log entries and run traces.
expected: Reads and aggregates up to 5000 audit entries off the UI thread asynchronously with 10s caching; UI remains responsive without stutter.

title: Messaging: Add Fake Contacts
steps: In Contacts window or terminal, add contact 'Self' with phone 15550100123.
Add contact 'Bob Work' with email fakebob@example.com.
expected: Contacts created with normalized names; phone numbers appear masked as ••••0123.

title: Messaging: Rate Limit Protection
steps: Attempt to send more than 5 messages within 10 minutes.
expected: Excess requests rejected by MessagingRateLimiter with cooldown notices.

title: Messaging: Demo Mode Refusal
steps: Run in demo mode.
Attempt a messaging command.
expected: Refused with message: 'Messaging is disabled in demo mode.'

title: Messaging: Contacts Window GUI
steps: Press Ctrl+K and select Contacts, or open from Settings.
expected: Themed Contacts window opens; lists contacts with masked numbers; Add, Edit, Delete work.

title: Messaging: Exact Text in Dialog
steps: Review confirmation dialog for message send request.
expected: Dialog shows exact plain-text preview; Enter defaults to Deny; Allow enables after 800ms cooldown.

title: Messaging: Deny Behavior
steps: Trigger text Self saying hello.
In ConfirmDialog, click Deny.
expected: Operation cancelled immediately; WhatsApp is not opened; history records user cancelled.

title: Messaging: Tainted Turn Blocking
steps: Read untrusted external document or web page.
Attempt messaging shortcut in same turn.
expected: Action strictly refused with error indicating messaging is blocked in tainted turns.

title: Messaging: Unknown Contact Refusal
steps: Type: 'text NonExistentContact saying hi'.
expected: Agent replies directly that contact does not exist without calling model or opening app.

title: Messaging: Duplicate Alias Refusal
steps: Attempt to add second contact with existing alias or normalized name.
expected: Rejected with ContactConflictError informing user name/alias is already in use.

title: Reminders: Set with Dialog
steps: In chat, enter: 'remind me in 1 minute to check tea'.
Click Allow on ConfirmDialog.
expected: ConfirmDialog appears with exact arguments; after Allow, reminder is saved.

title: Reminders: Focus Isolation
steps: While typing in input field, let reminder fire.
expected: ReminderToast appears in corner; keyboard focus is not stolen.

title: Reminders: Timer & Snooze
steps: Enter: 'set a timer for 10 seconds'.
Approve dialog.
When toast appears, click Snooze 5 min.
expected: Timer fires after 10s; clicking Snooze updates reminder due time to +300s.

title: Reminders: List & Cancel
steps: Enter: 'what reminders do i have'.
Enter: 'cancel reminder 1'.
Approve dialog.
expected: Active reminders listed; cancellation confirms deletion and removes it from store.

title: Reminders: Chain Isolation
steps: Enter: 'remind me in 2 minutes to stretch then pause'.
expected: Stays as single reminder with text 'stretch then pause'; does not split into chain.

title: Reminders: Missed on Restart
steps: Set reminder for 10s ahead.
Close ORBIT.
Wait 30s and reopen.
expected: On startup, missed-while-closed notice is displayed in chat.

title: Reminders: Dialog Collision
steps: Open a confirmation dialog.
Let reminder become due while dialog is open.
expected: Reminder does not pop conflicting toast over modal dialog; logs cleanly as chat line.

title: Reminders: Denied Reminder
steps: Enter: 'remind me in 5 minutes to submit report'.
Click Deny on ConfirmDialog.
expected: No reminder created; store count unchanged; does not appear in Reminders tab.

title: Routines: Create with Approval
steps: Enter: 'create a routine morning: open notepad then open calculator'.
expected: PlanDialog appears with title Save Routine, heading, steps, and Save button with 800ms cooldown.

title: Routines: Save Last Plan
steps: Execute a multi-step chain.
Enter: 'save that as a routine dev'.
expected: Confirmation dialog appears for saving last plan; approving saves steps under name dev.

title: Routines: Stop & Cancellation
steps: Run a multi-step routine.
While running, click the red Stop button.
expected: Plan runner immediately halts after current step and cancels pending steps cleanly.

title: Routines: Desktop Routines Tab
steps: Open Routines tab in desktop GUI.
expected: Displays table with Name, Steps, Last Run, Runs; Run, Show steps, and Delete buttons work.

title: Routines: Stale Allowlist Safety
steps: Remove app from ALLOWED_APPS after saving routine that uses it.
Attempt to run routine.
expected: Pre-execution re-validation detects stale app and refuses before step 1; zero steps execute.

title: Routines: Model & Safety Isolation
steps: Save and run routines.
Inspect LLM prompts, memory, and /diag.
expected: Model is never invoked for routine operations; /diag reports routine count only.

title: Settings: Single-Line In-Place Diff
steps: In terminal, run /set SPEAK_REPLIES 1.
Confirm y.
Inspect git diff .env.
expected: .env diff shows strictly that single line modified; comments and blank lines preserved; .env.bak created.

title: Settings: Stale ORBIT_MOCK Source
steps: Set ORBIT_MOCK=1 in terminal environment.
Run /settings or open Settings window.
expected: ORBIT_MOCK is displayed with effective value 1 and source environment.

title: Settings: Environment Override Flagged
steps: Define setting in .env, but override it via terminal environment before launching.
expected: Source shows environment (overridden); GUI row displays orange warning note.

title: Settings: Merged-Line Refusal
steps: Introduce merged line in .env.
Attempt to update setting via /set.
expected: Refuses to write with clear error naming line number and key name only; .env unchanged.

title: Settings: CRLF Preservation
steps: Save setting in .env formatted with CRLF line endings.
Check line endings of updated file.
expected: Resulting .env file retains CRLF line endings throughout with no conversion to LF.

title: System: Rate Limiting Protection
steps: Attempt volume adjustments exceeding 30/min or media controls > 10/min.
expected: Returns rate limit error and rejects excessive keystrokes.

title: System: Taint Escalation
steps: Read untrusted external file or page.
Issue system control command in same turn.
expected: Safe system tools escalate to confirmation with TAINT_WARNING.

title: Laptop: File Symlink Refusal
steps: Attempt to find or open a symlink or junction point.
expected: Refused; symlinks and reparse points are strictly excluded from results.

title: Laptop: File Double-Extension Refusal
steps: Attempt to search for or open report.pdf.exe or invoice.txt.vbs.
expected: Refused with security error: files with multiple or double extensions not allowed.

title: Laptop: Out of Range Index
steps: Type 'open file 9' or attempt to open candidate after TTL expires.
expected: Refused with clear error: No search result available.

title: Laptop: Screenshot Capture
steps: Type 'take a screenshot'.
expected: PNG saved to workspace/screenshots/ with timestamp; path returned; model-invisible.

title: Laptop: Screenshot Disk & Rate Limit
steps: Attempt capture with <100MB disk or trigger 21st screenshot within 1 hour.
expected: Refused with disk space error or rate limit message (20 per hour).

title: Laptop: Typing Non-Allowlist Refusal
steps: Type 'type hello into chrome'.
expected: Deterministically refused: I only type into notepad, whatsapp.

title: Laptop: Typing Focus Loss Abort
steps: Switch active window mid-typing (>20 chars).
expected: Typing loop detects foreground window changed and immediately aborts further strokes.

title: Laptop: Typing Rate Limit & Default Off
steps: Run typing 6 times within 10 minutes, or test default setting.
expected: Excess calls refused by rate limiter (max 5/10min); disabled by default.

title: Laptop: Elevation Refusal
steps: Attempt to focus an elevated admin window or protected process.
expected: Refused with error indicating window is running with elevated privileges.

title: Laptop: Non-Allowlist Refusal
steps: Type 'focus cmd' or attempt to control non-allowlisted process.
expected: Deterministically refused; only apps registered in ALLOWED_APPS can be controlled.

title: Laptop: File Search by Query & Kind
steps: Type 'find pdfs named report' or 'find photos of sunset'.
expected: Searches allowed user folders up to depth 4; returns top 5 sorted by mtime.

title: Laptop: File Search Recent & Downloads
steps: Type 'find my latest download' or 'find recent documents'.
expected: Scans Downloads or user folders, returning recent files with newest first.

title: Laptop: File Search Depth & Budget
steps: Search deep directory tree or exceed 2-second time budget.
expected: Scanning halts at depth 4 without traversing deeper subdirectories or exceeding budget.

title: Retrieval: Embedding Model Check
steps: Run doctor to inspect RAG embeddings check.
expected: Doctor reports embedding model reachability status.

title: Retrieval: Settings Configuration
steps: Enable RAG_EMBEDDINGS=1 and RAG_AUTO_SCORING=hybrid in settings.
expected: Effective settings report hybrid scoring enabled.

title: Retrieval: Document Indexing
steps: Run /index in terminal to index documents.
expected: Indexes document passages and generates chunk embeddings without error.

title: Retrieval: Diagnostics Telemetry
steps: Run /diag and inspect === RAG EMBEDDINGS === section.
expected: Shows embeddings enabled status, model name, chunk counts, and fallback reasons.

title: Retrieval: Lexical Fallback on Outage
steps: Configure invalid embedding model name.
Query document topic in chat.
expected: Answers returned via BM25 lexical fallback without errors; diag records fallback reason.

title: Retrieval: Prompt Citation Enforcement
steps: Ask question answered by workspace document.
Inspect response format.
expected: Cites document sources like [file#n] based strictly on retrieved passages.

title: Offline: Wi-Fi Disconnected Startup
steps: Launch ORBIT with ORBIT_OFFLINE=1.
expected: App starts immediately without hanging or attempting outbound HTTP connections.

title: Offline: Local Ollama Q&A
steps: While offline, ask arithmetic question and create local note.
expected: Local execution succeeds with zero network egress.

title: Offline: Network Egress Block
steps: While offline, attempt an external API call.
expected: Fails immediately with OfflineModeError without hanging on DNS timeouts.

title: Demo: Window Title & Status Chip
steps: Launch demo mode via scripts/demo.py.
expected: Window title displays DEMO MODE (sample data); status bar displays orange DEMO badge.

title: Demo: Storage Isolation
steps: In demo mode, create file 'notes/demo_test.txt'.
Inspect workspace/ and demo_home/workspace/.
expected: File created strictly in demo_home/workspace/; real workspace/ remains clean.

title: Demo: Settings Protection
steps: In demo mode, attempt /set SPEAK_REPLIES 1 or save settings in GUI.
expected: Rejection message: Settings can't be changed in demo mode; .env is not written.

title: Demo: Marker Reset Safety
steps: Pass non-empty directory without .orbit_demo marker to scripts/demo.py --home.
expected: Execution stops with error and deletes nothing (refusing to delete).

title: Demo: Path Invariance Unset
steps: Launch ORBIT without ORBIT_HOME.
Query paths via config.paths.
expected: All storage and log paths resolve to standard defaults; no redirection occurs.

title: Demo: Browser Profile Isolation
steps: In demo mode, open browser tool.
Inspect browser profile directory.
expected: Playwright uses clean demo_home/data/browser_profile/; personal cookies absent.

title: Security: Voice Confirmation Immunity
steps: Trigger a dangerous action requiring confirmation (e.g. open notepad).
When the confirmation dialog appears, speak 'yes', 'allow', or 'confirm' into the microphone.
expected: Voice input does nothing. Dialog does not close, approve, or execute the tool.

title: Security: Microphone Refused During Dialog
steps: Open any modal confirmation or plan dialog.
Attempt to activate the microphone via the Mic button or Ctrl+M shortcut.
expected: Microphone activation is strictly refused and a busy warning is surfaced.

title: Security: Taint Blocking for Sensitive Tools
steps: Instruct the agent to read an untrusted document or web page.
In the same turn, attempt to trigger messaging, typing, or computer sleep.
expected: The tool call is blocked with an error explaining that sensitive actions cannot execute in tainted turns.

title: Security: Non-Allowlisted Typing Refusal
steps: Enable typing controls.
Attempt to send keystrokes into a non-allowlisted window (e.g. cmd.exe or chrome.exe).
expected: Typing is deterministically refused before any keystrokes are dispatched.

title: Security: Executable Refusal in File Opener
steps: Attempt to open or reveal an executable file (.exe, .bat, .cmd, .ps1, or double extension).
expected: The file opener refuses the request immediately with an untrusted file type security error.

title: Security: Unknown Contact Message Refusal
steps: Request sending a WhatsApp message to an unregistered contact name.
expected: Refused deterministically without invoking the LLM or opening external applications.

title: Security: Model-Invisible Tool Refusal
steps: Attempt to invoke a model-invisible tool (e.g. take_screenshot) directly via LLM tool-calling schema.
expected: Tool is omitted from model-visible tool offerings; model cannot call it autonomously.

title: Security: Demo Settings Protection
steps: Run ORBIT in demo mode.
Attempt to modify settings via /set or the Settings GUI.
expected: Settings modification is blocked; .env and .env.bak remain untouched.

title: Security: No Secrets in /diag Output
steps: Run /diag in terminal or click System Info in GUI.
Examine diagnostics text for phone numbers, contact names, secret tokens, or personal file names.
expected: Diagnostics contains zero private contact data, unmasked phone numbers, or secret tokens.

title: Browser: Step 1 (Search)
steps: Enter: 'search wikipedia for Python' with BROWSER_ENABLED=1.
expected: Controlled Playwright browser opens, navigates to search, and extracts numbered results.

title: Browser: Step 2 (Click)
steps: Enter: 'click the first result'.
expected: Browser navigates to target page, verifies URL change, and updates session context.

title: Browser: Step 3 (Read)
steps: Enter: 'read the page summary'.
expected: Extracts visible text, truncates to safe length, and marks turn as tainted.

title: Browser: Step 4 (Scroll)
steps: Enter: 'scroll down 500 pixels'.
expected: Dispatches scroll delta and confirms vertical page movement.

title: Browser: Step 5 (Media)
steps: Navigate to approved media page.
Enter: 'pause the video'.
expected: Controller reads video DOM state and pauses playback without error.

title: Browser: Step 6 (Close)
steps: Enter: 'close the browser'.
Enter: 'what was the last site I visited?'.
expected: Browser closes cleanly; session context recalls last site from memory.

title: Messaging: Mailto Draft
steps: Type: 'email Bob Work about Project Update'.
Approve dialog.
expected: Default email client opens with draft addressed to fakebob@example.com with subject.

title: Messaging: Draft to Self
steps: Type: 'text Self saying hello from orbit'.
Inspect confirmation dialog.
expected: ConfirmDialog opens with preview indicating WhatsApp will be DRAFTED only without pressing Enter.

title: Messaging: Send Mode to Self
steps: Set WHATSAPP_SEND_MODE=send.
Type 'text Self saying automated test'.
Approve dialog.
expected: Verifies active window title and process, waits settle delay, re-verifies, and sends.

title: Messaging: Page-Derived Link
steps: In browser, navigate to a video.
Type 'send this link to Self'.
expected: Link to current video resolved and attached to WhatsApp draft preview.

title: Routines: Run with Preview
steps: Enter: 'run routine morning'.
expected: Upfront preview dialog displays header, lists steps, and Run button; runs through plan runner.

title: System: Volume Adjustment
steps: Issue command 'volume up' or 'turn volume up by 4'.
expected: Sends volume key strokes in 1-10 steps (~2% per step) with feedback notice.

title: System: Volume Mute Toggle
steps: Issue command 'mute volume'.
expected: Sends mute key stroke and reports unobservable state notice.

title: System: Media Playback Controls
steps: Issue command 'pause music' or 'next track'.
expected: Sends corresponding media key strokes without error.

title: System: Screen Lock Confirmation
steps: Issue command 'lock the screen'.
expected: Prompts for confirmation (CONFIRM); locks workstation only upon approval.

title: System: Settings Pages Opening
steps: Issue command 'open bluetooth settings'.
expected: Prompts confirmation, opens ms-settings:bluetooth upon approval.

title: Laptop: Window Focus & Restore
steps: Type 'switch to notepad' while Notepad is minimized.
expected: Notepad is restored if minimized and brought to active foreground.

title: Laptop: Open Found File with CONFIRM
steps: After searching, type 'open the first one'.
expected: Modal ConfirmDialog opens asking approval; clicking Allow opens file via default handler.

title: Laptop: Reveal File in Explorer
steps: Type 'reveal file 2 in explorer'.
expected: Modal ConfirmDialog opens; clicking Allow opens explorer.exe /select,path.

title: Laptop: Guarded Typing into Notepad
steps: Enable TYPING_ENABLED=1.
Type 'type hello world into notepad'.
expected: Dialog asks confirmation; focuses Notepad; types in 20-char chunks via SendInput.

title: Laptop: Window Minimize & Maximize
steps: Type 'minimize notepad' followed by 'maximize notepad'.
expected: Notepad minimizes to taskbar then expands to maximized state.

title: Laptop: Computer Sleep Confirmation
steps: Enable SLEEP_ENABLED=1.
Type 'put computer to sleep'.
expected: Modal ConfirmDialog opens asking approval; clicking Allow invokes SetSuspendState.

title: Laptop: Window Snap
steps: Type 'snap notepad left' and 'snap notepad right'.
expected: Notepad repositioned to fill exactly left or right half of monitor area.

title: Laptop: Show Desktop
steps: Type 'show desktop' or 'minimize all windows'.
expected: Minimizes open application windows to reveal desktop cleanly.
